title: It's 5 O'clock Somewhere in Nashville!
description:
Lounge poolside until the sun hangs low, take it easy by the fire pit, and see panoramic views of downtown as live music loosens your mood. Fins Beach Bar makes sure you’ll always have a drink within arm’s reach. And JWB Grill makes sure you can have your cheeseburger in paradise — and eat it, too.

The space
Raise your glass to Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham - Nashville. You won’t have to head all the way to the Caribbean to find your lost shaker of salt. In fact, it’s right upstairs at your resort’s rooftop bar.

Other things to note
Valet parking on-site is available for $57 per night. Self-parking is not available at this resort. Prices are subject to change.

Handicap & Hearing Impaired units are available if available upon request. All requests cannot be guaranteed but we will do our best to accommodate all guests.

The JWB Grill Bar will be closed for replumbing from Apr. 7 through Apr. 11, 2025. The restaurant will still be open for normal business with a mobile bar. Dates are subject to change.
